title: Blueprint
line: Drawn as an engineer draws a spring: axis, coils, hidden lines.
idea: Chalk line on diazo blue over a drafting grid. The Sun's path is a chain line, each helix solid where it passes in front of the axis and dashed where it is hidden behind it, the newest stretch in pencil yellow; a pitch dimension, a heading arrow and a title block draw on during the intro.
loop: The wakes unspool from the planets, then the coils run back along the axis as the system travels; the dashes ride along the helices.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in blueprint style: white chalk helices on a blue drafting grid, coiling back from a small yellow-rayed sun and its planets towards the upper left, dashed where they pass behind the sun's centre line, with a dimension line, an arrow and a title block.

title: Woodblock
line: Every wake a band of block colour, cut like a stream.
idea: Starts whole: an ukiyo-e print on washi under an ichimonji bokashi of Prussian blue. Each wake is a flat band of its planet's colour tapering back to a point, outlined by the key block a hair out of register and printed paler behind the Sun's line; dust falls as carved rain lines; a cartouche and a seal sit in the corner.
loop: The coloured bands wind back into the distance as the Sun travels, and the planets turn their indigo shadows away from it.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in Japanese woodblock-print style: coloured bands outlined in black spiralling back from a vermilion sun in an ochre halo, flat-coloured planets at their heads, under a deep blue sky band with carved stars, a title cartouche and a red seal in the corner.

title: Sumi Ink
line: Each wake one stroke of the brush, running dry as it goes back.
idea: Soot ink on bone rice paper. The Sun is a vermilion wash in a loaded ensō; each wake is one brush stroke pressed hard at the planet and lifting as it goes, its bristles parting into dry streaks, painted in diluted ink where the coil swings behind the Sun's line; the planets are dabs, with a column of writing and the seal in the corner.
loop: The strokes coil back into the paper as the system travels; their pressure and dry streaks travel with them.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in sumi ink: black brush-stroke spirals, pale where they pass behind, coiling back from a red sun in a black circle, planets as grey and black ink dabs, with a column of brushed characters and a red seal at the lower left.

title: Etching
line: Tone is only ever the density of lines, even in a spiral.
idea: Starts whole: a two-plate intaglio print inside its platemark. The cold plate hatches the sky in three bites, burnished clean along every wake; the warm plate engraves each wake as a ribbon between two contours, hatched across, cross-hatched where it runs behind the Sun's line, and models each planet with contour lines and cross-hatching.
loop: The engraved ribbons coil back across the fixed hatching of the sky, and the planets' hatched night sides turn as they swing round.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in etching style: brown engraved ribbons, hatched across, spiralling back from a ringed sun in a burst of fine rays, on a finely cross-hatched sky inside a ruled border with an engraved corner fan and lettering.

title: Riso
line: Solid in front, screened behind, and everything an overprint.
idea: Starts whole: a risograph poster in medium blue, fluorescent pink and yellow on warm stock. Each wake is a halftone band of its planet's recipe of inks, solid at the planet and stepping down to a thinner screen back along the helix, half strength behind the Sun's line; each ink is its own misregistered plate.
loop: The bands wind back through screens that stay fixed to the page, as a printed tone would; dust drifts past as flecks of yellow.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in risograph poster style: bright halftone bands in yellow, pink, green and violet spiralling back from an orange sun across a blue halftone sky with yellow stars, printed slightly out of register inside a paper margin.

title: Stipple
line: Every coil, every shadow, one dot at a time.
idea: Starts whole: lamp-black and a sunset rose on grey laid paper. Each wake is a dotted band, fewer dots the further back and thinner behind the Sun's line, rose for its newest stretch; the orbits are chains of dots, the Sun a rose sphere, each planet a stippled sphere lit from the Sun.
loop: The dots are keyed to the moments they mark, so they ride back along the helices; the planets go from crescent to full as they swing round.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in stipple: spirals made of black dots, rose near the planets, coiling back from a sun of rose dots through dotted orbit rings on pale grey paper, with dotted planets and a sky darkening to the corners.

title: Pastel on Black
line: On black paper, the wake of every planet is drawn in light.
idea: Starts whole: soft pastel on dark toothy paper. The Sun is hundreds of radiating strokes; each wake is a smudge of its planet's colour, a broad soft pass with a firmer line down its middle, dimmer behind the Sun's line; each planet is lit in its own colour where the Sun reaches it, all of it broken by the tooth and bloomed.
loop: The glowing spirals wind back into the dark as the system travels, chalk dust streams past, and the stars twinkle a whole number of times per loop.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in pastel on black paper: glowing coloured spirals in blue, violet, gold and orange coiling back from a bright chalk sun, planets lit on their sunward side, among twinkling stars.

title: Cut Paper
theme: Strips of paper in a spiral
line: Every wake a string of paper strips, darker as it goes.
idea: Starts whole: a paper diorama on a night-navy ground with punched stars. Each wake is a string of overlapping scissor-cut strips, the planet's own paper at the head and darker stock back along the spiral, each lifted with a soft shadow; the Sun is three layers of paper and the planets are paper discs with pasted pieces.
loop: Each strip rides the helix as one piece of paper as the coils wind back, and the Sun's paper star turns once.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in layered cut paper: overlapping paper strips in cream, blue, teal, red and tan spiralling back from an orange paper sun, casting soft shadows, with paper planets at their heads on a navy background with paper-punch stars.

title: Bauhaus
line: Colour in front, a black line behind, and circles at the end.
idea: Starts whole: a screen print on bone paper in black, red, yellow and blue. Each wake is a hard-edged band of flat colour stepping down in width where the coil swings in front of the Sun's line, a fine black line where it passes behind, breaking into black circles at its tail; the Sun's path is a heavy rule with a yellow circle for every year of Mercury's.
loop: The bands wind back along the rule as the system travels; each planet's black part keeps turning from the Sun; dust drifts past as small black squares.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in Bauhaus style: red, yellow, blue and black bands spiralling back from a red and yellow sun along a heavy black line dotted with yellow circles, over thin black orbit ellipses, with a black band, a red square and a blue quarter circle framing it.

title: Art Deco
line: Gold pinstripes on lacquer, wound into a spiral.
idea: Starts whole: gold line on black lacquer inside a stepped frame with corner fans, over peacock-teal wedges radiating from the Sun. Each wake is a pinstripe of three gold rules closing into one as it runs back, a single pale rule behind the Sun's line; the Sun's path is a double rule set with gold diamonds.
loop: The pinstripes wind back into the dark as the system travels, the planets turn their engraved faces to the Sun, sparkles flash in turn, and a sheen crosses all the gold once.
poster: Three seconds into the loop, the configuration every piece rests on (the same one as the top-down set's posters).
alt: Sketch in art deco style: fine gold spiral pinstripes coiling back from a spiked gold sunburst over teal wedges on black lacquer, gold-ringed planets engraved with fine lines, inside a stepped gold frame with fan-shaped corners.
